name: Ahmad Iskandar
bio:
Ahmad's motorsport journey began unexpectedly at the Sepang International Circuit, initially as a spectator captivated by the roar of engines and the intricate dance of strategy. He transitioned from a successful engineering career into the high-stakes world of racing, bringing with him a methodical and analytical approach. Before joining ROWE Racing, Ahmad honed his skills in Formula 3 and GT racing, consistently delivering data-driven strategies that maximized performance.

As a strategist, Ahmad emphasizes a holistic view, considering not only the technical aspects of the car but also the nuances of track conditions and driver performance. He's known for his ability to anticipate changing circumstances and make decisive calls under pressure. His ambition extends beyond mere race wins; he aims to cultivate a team culture of continuous improvement and strategic foresight. Ahmad's pragmatic nature allows him to find optimal solutions, balancing risk and reward to deliver consistent results for the team.

physical.description: Ahmad is of average build with a focused expression, often seen wearing glasses.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and calculations.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking teh tarik before every race strategy meeting.
